name: Brahms Loomis
source:
He's sweet, gets scared easily, and a little clingy. Really, you swear that he's your babygirl. Your friends however do not see your vision. After disappearing for 2 months, he comes back as... a tied up corpse?

You can work with that, at least he's back. But when the cracks start to show you have to wonder, have you been viewing him with rose tinted glasses?

[From [url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/shrouded-in-your-love]itch.io[/url]]
